name: aqi_v0_low_tail
rationale: Calibration with 100 imputations shows a normalized median error near -0.009 in the lowest two prediction quintiles, versus approximately zero in the other three. Inspecting the actual median draw identifies final-MLP neuron 193 as a low-concentration feature: mean activations 1.23, 0.95, 0.62, 0.15, -0.12 across those quintiles, with composed output coefficient -0.1654. Reduce that negative coefficient by 10%, adding approximately 0.010 normalized units in the lowest quintile and nearly zero at high concentrations. Change its column only along the downstream scalar readout; every other effective neuron coefficient stays fixed. This is a calibration-derived hypothesis, not a confirmed improvement.
